'''Kaylanna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She served as the [[Irstat-Kes]] of the Tarasin [[Nirrani tribe]] and when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] summoned the Tarasin leaders to hold a ''[[vurgat]]'' ceremony, Kaylanna represented the Niirani at the proceedings. Kaylanna incorrectly believed that it was [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Dariana]] of the [[Hiironi irstat]] who had called for the ritual to take place, and she demanded that Dariana tell the Tarasin leaders why they had been summoned.
